cheapest_decisive_test.action: scripts/run_t20260930_12_smallcap_gap_auction.py: premarket (per-month minute-archive summary, checkpointed) then screen (3 calibers x 4 cells, windows, t and Newey-West t, 100-seed same-pool placebo, same-pool baseline), under run_capped 1.5G; results.json.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Any of the three fails for X15_K10_EW; then X0 is read for the paid-data question and LA for the look-ahead share.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: X15_K10_EW: main mean >= 20 bp/day and ordinary t >= 2.0; main placebo beat fraction >= 0.90; short-window mean >= 10 bp/day.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: Cheapest-negation stage charges no cost. Ledger stage (if reached): 5 bp per side base, 10 bp per side stress, 10/20 bp per side frozen contract, one round trip per day. Selection cutoffs: X15 last bar starting 09:11 ET (free-plan 15-minute-delayed SIP at a 09:27 submission), X0 last bar starting 09:26 ET (paid real-time SIP). Fill at daily open / daily close (official prints within tolerance per C1). OPG submission deadline 09:28 ET.
existing_solution_comparison: Published gap-fade evidence (Concretum 2026, gross Sharpe about 2.08, cost-blind) and the liquidity-provision reading (Nagel 2012; Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019) support a reversal after overnight moves, but no source tests a selection made only from pre-market prices at the $5-20M dollar-volume tier before the OPG deadline. Alpaca docs (opened 2026-09-30): free plan real-time is IEX only and SIP history has the latest-15-minutes limit, Algo Trader Plus is $99/month; OPG orders after 09:28 ET are rejected. Reuse: T-32 pool construction, hygiene and split filter, and C1 official-price findings are imported unchanged.
negative_experiments_checked: oc research directions check gap fade premarket (2026-09-30): dir:cross_sectional_gap_fade refuted at T-32 (short-leg gross +11.5 bp, cost-killed), reopen_if satisfied by C1's auction-price path; C1 (t20260930_11) closed the >=$20M tiers at 7.09 bp/day < 8 bp and queued this T1 long leg (C1b). dir:overnight_intraday_gap_retail_pwb refuted (fixed overnight hold, different mechanism). Difference from the refuted lines: small-cap tier, long only, pre-market-only selection, look-ahead controlled.
objective: T-20260930-12 (C1b): with only information available before 09:27 ET (SIP pre-market minute bars visible on the free plan up to the 09:11 bar, or to 09:26 on paid real-time SIP), does the $5-20M dollar-volume gap-down long (K lowest z, open buy, close sell) keep >= 20 bp/day gross, and beat a same-pool random basket placebo? Registry direction dir:cross_sectional_gap_fade (refuted at T-20260929-32 after per-stock costs; C1 closed the >=$20M tiers and left the $5-20M long leg at +42.5 bp/day with a look-ahead in the selection price).

remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the +42.5 bp/day C1 long-leg edge survives when the gap is measured from the last pre-market bar visible before the deadline (09:11 bar on the free plan, 09:26 bar on paid real-time SIP) instead of the opening print; whether it beats a same-pool random basket. Not measured: opening-auction impact of our orders, fill reliability of paper OPG orders (45 of 50 expired on 2026-09-15), borrow (long only, none), fees. Survivorship bias: data/sip/daily has no delisted names.

sources.applicability: Frames the second cost item (opening-auction impact) that this step does not measure and that the full preregistration must stress; supports entering at the open only in small size or by limit orders.
sources.claim: Goyal, Jegadeesh and Wu (JFQA 2026, NYSE and Nasdaq 2012-2021): closing auctions carry about 10% of daily volume and have lower price impact than the continuous market for all stocks except Nasdaq microcaps; opening auctions are illiquid (opening auction volume is 5%-10% of closing auction volume, under 1.5% of ADV after 2015) and carry the largest price impact; long/short anomaly portfolios cost 17-41 bp per year, 9-21 bp excluding microcaps in closing auctions.
sources.independent_replication: Working-paper version SSRN 4300417 (2022); no independent replication found.
sources.limitations: Costs are annualized for low-turnover anomaly portfolios, not a daily-turnover book; price impact is measured for institutional-size orders, not the effect of the auction price vs daily-bar open, which is what this step measures.
sources.market_and_period: NYSE and Nasdaq stocks, 2012-2021, TAQ plus exchange auction files

sources.applicability: Fixes the official-price rule: official open = trade with condition Q, else O; official close = M, else 6.
sources.claim: UTP Plan specification (Sept 2026 edition) sale-condition table: Q = Market Center Official Open, O = Opening Prints, M = Market Center Official Close, 6 = Closing Prints; direct data recipients should use the Q value as the official market center opening value.
sources.limitations: Nasdaq (UTP) specification; the CTA equivalent for NYSE and NYSE American tapes A and B uses the same letters but is a separate document not fetched here; the check5 step verifies the codes against real trades.
sources.market_and_period: Nasdaq-listed (tape C) UTDF feed, current specification

sources.applicability: Tells us the daily-bar open and close are built from a rule set that can exclude Q and M prints, so official auction prices can differ from the daily-bar open/close, which is the paired difference measured here.
sources.claim: Alpaca Market Data FAQ: the rules that decide which trades update a bar depend on tape (A, B NYSE; C Nasdaq; O OTC), the trade conditions and the bar type; a trade can have more than one condition and the strictest rule applies; the table lists per-condition whether open/close, high/low and volume are updated.
sources.limitations: The FAQ is a rendered web page; the exact per-condition table is read from the page text; there is no versioned date on the page, the published date recorded is the fetch-time year.
sources.market_and_period: Alpaca Market Data API, SIP feed, current documentation

sources.applicability: Confirms that split of returns between close-to-open and open-to-close is a stable feature; the gap-fade signal trades the intraday leg after the overnight gap.
sources.claim: Lou, Polk and Skouras (JFE 2019): for 14 trading strategies, profits are earned entirely overnight (reversal and a variety of momentum strategies) or entirely intraday, typically with profits of opposite signs across the two components.
sources.independent_replication: Subsequent literature (Akbas et al. 2022, cited by Concretum) reports similar patterns.
sources.limitations: Uses first-print or official open depending on the data set and no transaction costs; not a tradability study.
sources.market_and_period: US stocks, CRSP, decades of daily open/close data

sources.applicability: Justifies the parent experiment T-32 per-stock spread cost that this step tries to bypass with auction prices.
sources.claim: Abdi and Ranaldo (RFS 2017): a bid-ask spread estimator from daily close, high and low prices gives the highest cross-sectional and average time-series correlations with the TAQ effective spread when quote data are unavailable, and the most accurate estimates for less liquid stocks.
sources.limitations: Estimator accuracy is highest for monthly averages, noisy for single stock-days.
sources.market_and_period: US stocks, TAQ effective spread benchmark, 1993-2012

sources.applicability: Interprets the gap-fade edge as liquidity provision, which competes with the spread we would have to pay; edge concentrates in high-VIX periods.
sources.claim: Nagel (RFS 2012, NBER WP 17653): returns of short-term reversal strategies proxy for the returns to liquidity provision; the expected return is strongly time-varying and predictable with the VIX, rising sharply in turmoil.
sources.independent_replication: Replicated in follow-up papers on reversal and liquidity.
sources.limitations: Monthly/weekly reversal, not intraday gap fade; paid liquidity means the edge and the cost are linked.

sources.applicability: Fixes the X15 information set: at 09:27 ET the newest SIP minute bar visible on the free plan starts at 09:11 and ends 09:12; X0 (bars to 09:26) needs the paid real-time SIP.
sources.claim: Alpaca Trading API market data plans: the free Basic plan (default for paper and live accounts) has real-time IEX only for equities and the SIP historical data is limited to the latest 15 minutes; Algo Trader Plus ($99/month) covers all US exchanges in real time with no historical restriction.
sources.limitations: Plan table on a live documentation page without a version date (updated_at is the fetch date); the project .env feed is IEX, so the SIP 15-minute rule is what a free-plan job at 09:27 ET would see; pricing can change.

sources.applicability: The signal must be computed before 09:28 ET (design uses 09:27), which is why the opening print cannot be used for selection (C1's lookahead) and why the pre-market cutoffs 09:11 / 09:26 are used.
sources.claim: Alpaca orders: OPG (market/limit on open) orders execute only in the opening auction and unfilled remainder is cancelled; OPG orders submitted after 9:28am and before 7:00pm ET are rejected; a market order entered between 9:28:01 and 9:29:59 on a Nasdaq security does not get the Nasdaq Official Opening Price.
sources.limitations: Documents order acceptance, not fill quality; paper opening-auction fills were unreliable on 2026-09-15 (45 of 50 orders expired).

stop_condition: Frozen in hypotheses.md before any pre-market bar is read: continue only if X15_K10_EW has main-window gross mean >= 20 bp/day with ordinary t >= 2.0, main-window placebo beat fraction >= 0.90 (100 same-pool random K-basket seeds), and short-window mean >= 10 bp/day. X15 fail and X0 pass: blocked on a paid SIP decision. Both fail: closed (look-ahead if LA >= 20 bp, else unstable). No change to pool, K, weights, windows or gates after seeing results.
target_regime_and_horizon: Benchmark window 2024-01-08 to 2026-09-29 (contaminated: C1 saw it), short window 2023-02-01 to 2024-01-05; one-day hold from the daily-bar open to the close, long only. A gross-edge measurement; a pass licenses a ledger and a forward shadow record from 2026-10-01, not trading. Validity ends if the forward 63-session gross mean falls below 20 bp/day.
